overall_reason: The 'Add a note' to 'Note added' swap is continuity feedback with a short fade and blur, but it animates margin-block, which pushes the neighbouring 'Optional' label off its line; the sweep's 4 px shove is that symptom.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails because the change moves a neighbour that did not change; T-PURPOSE and T-FREQUENCY pass for the 250 ms swap.

findings.where: span.ts-unstable__item 'Note added' and its neighbour span.ts-secondary 'Optional', 1440
findings.evidence: The entering item transitions margin-block from 4px -4px to 0 over 0.3 s on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). In the 2608 ms still 'Optional' sits about 4 px below its 1613 ms position, and the sweep's motion_snap passive_shove hit reports 'Optional' jumping +4 px on y at 1733 ms.
findings.before: margin-block 4px -4px to 0 over 300 ms on the swapping label
findings.after: Move the entering label with transform: translateY(4px) to none over the same 300 ms and keep margin fixed, so 'Optional' never moves
findings.why: Only the label changed, yet the secondary text jumps; the eye follows the jump instead of the new label.

strengths: The label swap itself is a quick crossfade: the old item leaves in 150 ms and the new one arrives in 250 ms on ease-out after a 70 ms delay, so the exit is shorter than the entrance.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
